status: Local integration candidate verified; publication is row21

fixes.result: OpenAPI declares opaque HTTP Bearer on authorized operations. Scalar shows the Bearer token input. Anonymous sign-in remains public; runtime permissions unchanged.
Dispatch list reloads on entry so an already-started trip no longer appears In preparation from cached state.
Weighing and guide links use a continuous inline-block target, including the space between wrapped lines. Mouse and Enter navigation verified.

verification.nativeMySql: Pass: migration chain, fleet/A01 domain, weighing/guide audit atomicity, trip concurrency and rollback, photo/audit retry, reception ownership/exact guide and conformant idempotent close with trip release
verification.productionLocal: Separate database, migrations, administrator bootstrap idempotency, no demo records, Firebase CORS, persisted key ring and Bearer surviving process restart
verification.browser: Resident creates order8 (4 units). Warehouse approves, creates dispatch24, assigns vehicle, records net100/expected100/tolerance2 kg, issues GD-00000024 and starts trip24 using warehouse/site circular geofences. Return to list shows In transit, preparation KPI2 and transit KPI13. Weighing link click and guide Enter/click work. Scalar exposes Bearer input.
verification.rateLimit: Initial combined run reached authentication429. Runner now respects the existing window between suite groups; final371-check run passed with rate limiting enabled. No security relaxation.
verification.scope: Isolated local MySQL fixtures; GPS is simulated HTTP telemetry, not real hardware. Browser traversal is order through departure; receipt, photo, case and PDF assertions are HTTP/native tests. No new cloud or full WCAG acceptance.

reproduce: Start scripts/start-local.ps1 with a separate local candidate database and port5179; keep private configuration outside Git.
Run python scripts/verify-candidate.py --allow-local-writes --wait-for-auth-window. It creates local fixtures and writes ignored .local/candidate-results.json.
Run scripts/verify-production.ps1 on a separate local port/database with the private configuration file.
Frontend: node --test scripts/*.test.mjs and node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build.
